teaser.en: To a sunbird, this mistletoe is as precious as a coconut palm is to people.
teaser.sw: Kwa chozi, kimelea hiki ni cha thamani kama mnazi ulivyo kwa binadamu.
teaser.dg: Kpwa tsozi, mmea uhu una samani dza mnazi kpwa atu.

summary.en: Mnazi wa tsozi is a mistletoe that grows high on the branches of other trees. Its name, 'the sunbird's coconut tree', comes from the sunbirds that visit its flowers.
summary.sw: Mnazi wa tsozi ni kimelea (*mistletoe*) kinachoota juu kwenye matawi ya miti mingine. Jina lake, 'mnazi wa chozi', linatokana na ndege aina ya chozi wanaotembelea maua yake.
summary.dg: *Mnazi wa tsozi* ni mmea unaomera dzulu ya panda za mihi yanjina (*mistletoe*). Dzinare, 'mnazi wa tsozi', rinatuluka kpwa tsozi anaokpwedza kpwenye maruwage.

about.en:
*Mnazi wa tsozi* is a mistletoe, a shrubby plant that grows on the branches of trees and draws water and nutrients from its host. It forms clumps of thick, leathery leaves high in the crown. Its tubular flowers are rich in nectar and are visited by sunbirds, which also spread the sticky seeds from branch to branch.

Pakia's informants identified it from the look of the whole plant.
about.sw:
*Mnazi wa tsozi* ni kimelea (*mistletoe*), mmea wa kichaka unaoota kwenye matawi ya miti na kufyonza maji na virutubisho kutoka kwa mti mwenyeji wake. Hufanya mafungu ya majani mazito, magumu kama ngozi, juu kwenye taji la mti. Maua yake yenye umbo la mrija yana asali tele na hutembelewa na chozi, ambao pia hueneza mbegu zake zinazonata kutoka tawi moja hadi jingine.

Watoa taarifa wa Pakia walikitambua kwa sura ya mmea mzima.
about.dg:
*Mnazi wa tsozi* ni *mistletoe*, mmea dza chitsaka unaomera dzulu ya panda za mihi na kufyondza madzi na chakurya kula kpwa muhi unaoukala. Unahenda mafungu ga makodza magumu dza chingo dzulu sana kpwenye muhi. Maruwage ni dza mabomba madide, gana madzi ga mtswano manji, na ganakpwedzerwa ni tsozi, ambao piya nkuhala tembe zinazonyata kula panda mwenga hadi yanjina.

Atu ariomterya Pakia anaumanya kpwa kuulola mmea wosi.

where.en: It grows on trees in coastal bushland and woodland, wherever there are suitable hosts.
where.sw: Kinaota juu ya miti katika vichaka na mapori ya miti ya pwani, popote palipo na miti mwenyeji inayofaa.
where.dg: Unamera dzulu ya mihi weruni na matsakani ga pwani, phatu phosi phenye mihi inayoufwaha.

culture.en: Pakia records that *mnazi wa tsozi* is also used as a name for parasitic plants in general, as *chiahira* is for epiphytes.
culture.sw: Pakia anaandika kwamba *mnazi wa tsozi* pia hutumika kama jina la mimea vimelea kwa ujumla, kama vile *chiahira* lilivyo kwa mimea inayoota juu ya mimea mingine bila kuinyonya (*epiphytes*).
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala *mnazi wa tsozi* piya nkuhumirwa dza dzina ra mimea yosi inayoishi kpwa kufyondza mihi yanjina, dza *chiahira* irivyo kpwa mimea inayomera dzulu ya mihi yanjina bila kuifyondza.

names.en: *Mnazi wa tsozi* means 'coconut tree of the sunbird'. Sunbirds visit the flowers so often that the plant is thought of as being as important to them as the coconut palm is to people. The Mgombato dictionary defines *tsozi* as 'sunbird; one of a number of small birds with slender curved bills and bright plumage'. Pakia notes that the name is not related to *mnazi*, the coconut, in any other way. There is no English or Swahili name in the sources.
names.sw: *Mnazi wa tsozi* maana yake ni 'mnazi wa chozi'. Chozi hutembelea maua yake mara nyingi kiasi kwamba mmea huu unachukuliwa kuwa muhimu kwao kama mnazi ulivyo kwa binadamu. Kamusi ya Mgombato inafasili *tsozi* kuwa 'chozi; mmoja wa ndege wadogo kadhaa wenye midomo myembamba iliyopinda na manyoya yenye rangi angavu'. Pakia anabainisha kwamba jina hili halina uhusiano mwingine wowote na *mnazi*, mnazi wa nazi. Vyanzo havitoi jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili.
names.dg: *Mnazi wa tsozi* rina mana ya 'mnazi wa tsozi'. Tsozi anakpwedza kpwenye maruwage mara nyinji sana hata mmea uhu nkuonwa kukala ni muhimu kpwao dza mnazi urivyo muhimu kpwa atu. Kamusi ya Mgombato inaeleza *tsozi* kukala ni 'tsozi; mwenga wa ndege adide anji enye miromo myembamba iriyopindika na nyoya za rangi zinazong'ala'. Pakia anaandika kukala dzina hiri tarihusiana na *mnazi*, mnazi, kpwa njira yoyosi yanjina. Kpwenye vitabu takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili.
